experiment: P3o-U deployable local time-frequency phase-dynamics conditional ISRJ calibration
hypothesis: fixed local phase dynamics add source-FPR reduction beyond posterior-only capacity and time-bin-shuffled controls

conditions.U0_base: frozen base logits and original safe thresholds
conditions.U1_posterior_only_capacity_control: detached p(MFT|x) through equal-capacity residual; no local features
conditions.U2_local_phase_dynamics: U1 plus fixed local STFT and instantaneous-phase-dynamics features
conditions.U3_timebin_shuffled_phase_control: U2 feature dimensions with deterministic time-bin permutation before the residual

feature_contract.normalization: per-sample RMS before phase/STFT; fixed per-feature LayerNorm in residual

evaluation.secondary_thresholds: same selection-only CP threshold routine for every condition
evaluation.parameter_gate: predicted labels primary; oracle-positive diagnostic only

stop_rule: Any failed gate freezes P3o-U data/code/output; no confirmation generation and no retuning on these identities.
